ai.overview: Paris FC puts the lineal championship belt on the line for the first time in this reign when they host Angers SCO on November 22, 2026. The belt, which passes to whoever beats the current holder regardless of league standings, has never been contested between these two sides despite eight all-time meetings. Angers SCO, a 22-time belt holder historically, will look to reclaim the strap from a Paris FC side that has yet to defend it.
key_matchups: Paris FC's unbeaten home form this season (3-0-2 overall) against an Angers side that has struggled on the road, losing 0-2 at Lille and 1-2 to Rennes in recent weeks
The head-to-head history favors Angers with 2 wins to Paris FC's 1 across 8 meetings, though 5 have ended in draws including a 0-0 stalemate in their last encounter on January 25, 2026
Paris FC's recent attacking output (3-2 at Marseille, 3-0 vs Nice, 2-1 vs Strasbourg) versus Angers' mixed defensive record (clean sheet vs Troyes, but conceded 2 to Lille and Rennes)
ai.betting_angles: Paris FC enters as a clear Elo favorite and boasts superior form with a 3-0-2 record compared to Angers' 2-2-1 mark. Both teams have won their last 1 game, but Paris FC has shown more consistency with three wins in their last five, while Angers has dropped two of five. The head-to-head history slightly favors Angers, though five of eight meetings have been draws, including the most recent 0-0 result.
ai.prediction_writeup: Paris FC should successfully defend the belt for the first time in this reign based on their stronger overall form and home advantage. Their 3-0-2 record reflects a side that has found ways to win, including impressive results like the 3-2 victory at Olympique Marseille. While Angers holds a slight edge in the all-time series and has held the belt 22 times previously, their 2-2-1 record and road struggles suggest they'll fall short. The Elo model's clear favor toward Paris FC aligns with the recent form that has seen the hosts score in three of their last five, including the 2-1 win over Strasbourg in their most recent outing.
